system.description:
It is a challenge to regain your senses in the midst of a reckless fury. At the end of any round, you may try to calm yourself down. Make a prevail check vs. 10 + the number on your bloodlust die.

On a success, you end your bloodlust: make a recovery x, where x is the number on your bloodlust die. You then lose your bloodlust die for the rest of the encounter. At the end of a combat, you regain senses automatically, and you can make the recovery if you want. This still counts as a combat recovery, meaning you roll the dice instead of taking the highest value.
